notes.title: Bugfix Update #3
notes.notes:
We received several reports of typos from our wonderful fans and testers. Today's patch should remedy most of them. Thank you for all of your feedback!
- Fixed a typo in Cyltan's dialog in Chapter 9, a typo in Hilda's dialog in Chapter 13
- Fixed a typo in Hilda's dialog for when a certain character dies
- Fixed a typo in Sheela's dialog in Chapter 3, and a typo in the opening narration dialog.

notes.title: Vestaria Saga I Soundtrack PIANO ARRANGEMENT & 8-BIT MUSIC VERSION is complete!
notes.notes:
Dear Vestaria Saga fans,

Thank you very much for your patience! We are pleased to announce that the Vestaria Saga I Soundtrack PIANO ARRANGEMENT & 8-BIT MUSIC VERSION is now complete and available in full for Steam!

Not only that, but the complete version includes more tracks than originally planned! The album now consists of seven brand-new piano arrangements (2 more than planned), seventeen 8-bit versions (6 more than planned) and seven original tracks, for a total of 31 tracks! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1216180/Vestaria_Saga_I_Soundtrack_PIANO_ARRANGEMENT__8BIT_MUSIC_VERSION/

Furthermore, the format of the album has been changed from "DLC" to "Soundtrack," which means the album can be purchased independently from the game. If you have already purchased the album via DLC, you now have access to the full album. In order to access it, please follow these steps:

Open Vestaria Saga in your Steam Library
Find the album under 'Additional Content' on the right of the landing page and click it
Click the 'Download Album' button on the details screen
Choose the download location of your choice (the default directory is Program Files (x86)/Steam/steamapps/music/ )

We hope you all enjoy the this new, exclusive album by Hiroto Saitoh!

notes.title: Bugfix Update #2
notes.notes:
We hope you're still enjoying the world of Vestaria Saga. Today we released a small patch to address a few more bugs/issues.

1. Orison and Mettle skill descriptions fixed.
2. Empyrean Wings item wielder list fixed.
3. Various typos fixed.
4. Untranslated dialog line fixed.

notes.title: Bugfix Update #1
notes.notes:
We hope you're all enjoying the world of Vestaria Saga. Today we released a small patch to address issues that were brought to our attention. Thank you all for your patience and support, and please don't hesitate to let us know if you find something else.

- Green background at the end of the Grand Opening has been removed.
- 'Cutlass' dialog text error in the Prologue has been fixed.
- Fire Breath I description has been fixed.
- Typo in Zurne's dialog in Chapter 2 has been fixed.

notes.title: Vestaria Saga I: War of the Scions will release on December 27th, 2019!
notes.notes:
Dear Vestaria Saga fans,

We are thrilled to announce the release date for Vestaria Saga I: War of the Scions on December 27th, 2019! Thank you for being so patient since the start of this project. We are truly happy to be able to deliver the game in full to the English speaking world. 

Please set aside some time during your holiday break to dive into this fantastic strategy RPG! 
Thank you for your support!

- DANGEN Entertainment
